free_tier.stated: Shared virtual servers from a Guro Digital Complex IDC: VM-XS is 1 vCPU, 1 GB memory, 25 GB HDD and 600 GB a month of outbound at KRW 5,040 a month on a 12-month commitment, with inbound unlimited and not billed. VM-S is 2 vCPU with 2 GB and 50 GB at KRW 11,790, VM-M 4 vCPU with 4 GB at 21,600, VM-L 6 vCPU at 31,500 and VM-XL 8 vCPU at 41,400. Overage is KRW 70 per GB to 1,000 GB and KRW 60 per GB above it.

notes: XDN is a one-site reseller in Seoul and its page is written as a price comparison against iwinv, which it names; the comparison rows are reported and the XDN rows are documented. The disk is HDD, not NVMe, which is why the price undercuts iwinv. A reseller of this size carries the reliability risk this class is defined by, and no suspension or disappearance event was found for it, so the reliability note is that nothing was observed either way. the card identity cost is inferred from a monthly or hourly billing model, and the signup page is the route that would settle it.
